tests.name: The whole host delta is exactly one existing-helper import and one JSON writer replacement

Installed writer drops the stale note for reverted source
Identical bytes under a different source path cannot borrow the old note
An artifact-bound rasterReceipt cannot ride the source-preservation path
An artifact-bound approvedBy cannot ride the source-preservation path
An artifact-bound verdict cannot ride the source-preservation path
Missing, invalid and unannotated previous receipts retain ordinary serialization behavior
The actual unannotated production-field-map.json output is unchanged byte-for-byte
The actual unannotated reports/rendered-artifacts.json output is unchanged byte-for-byte
The retained source receipt and installed host were not mutated by writer tests
